snp5.15:1.1: To one who reveals the past
snp5.15:1.4: who has gone to the beyond of all phenomena,
snp5.15:1.5: I’ve come with a desire for a question. I ask the Sakyan about the knowledge
snp5.15:2.1: of one devoid of perception of forms,
snp5.15:2.2: who has abandoned all the body, every body,
snp5.15:2.3: who sees, within & without, ‘There is nothing’:
snp5.15:3.1: The Buddha: The Tathāgata, knowing directly
snp5.15:3.4: knows for one stationed in them
snp5.15:4.2: the origin of nothingness to be the fetter of delight,
